raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the origin language was Old French (“Silvestre”) and even directed a synthesis stating “The origin language is Old French (via Latin).” This conflated a later transmission pathway with the true etymological origin. Multiple sources (Etymonline, Wikipedia, Geneanet) consistently indicate the ultimate origin is Latin (silvestris/silva), which also aligns with the Charlemagne era’s dominant scholarly/liturgical language being Latin.
